rules.statement: The undertaking is annual (1 January–31 December), renews automatically unless deregistered, and ends if the minimum participation or required combination is not met.

conditions.description: Measure is requested for the funding year.

result.description: Annual contract remains valid only while its conditions are met.

rules.statement: Tierwohl – Behirtung requires simultaneous participation in Almbewirtschaftung.

conditions.description: The required combination is active.

result.description: Combination condition is met.

rules.statement: At least 3.00 herded ruminant livestock units (RGVE) must participate in every funding year.

conditions.description: Annual total of eligible herded RGVE.

result.description: Minimum participation is satisfied; otherwise the contract expires.

rules.statement: Only milk cows, other cattle, sheep, goats, equids and New World camelids are requestable categories; all animals of each requested category must be herded.

conditions.description: A selected category may not be only partly herded.

result.description: Requested category is complete.

rules.statement: Milk animals are milk cows, milk sheep or milk goats milked for at least 45 days on one or more alpine pastures; cows must be age 2 and have calved by 1 July, milked sheep/goats age 1 by that date.

conditions.description: Milk classification requirements.

result.description: Animal may be requested as milk livestock.

rules.statement: Each animal must be herded for at least 60 days and each alpine pasture stocked for at least 60 days; arrival counts, departure does not, interruptions do not count, and consecutive animals can meet pasture stocking duration.

conditions.description: Days are calculated excluding interruptions and departure day.

result.description: Minimum animal and alpine-pasture duration is met.

rules.statement: Cattle, sheep and goats moved to another herded alpine pasture are allocated to each pasture pro rata to total alpine duration, but must total at least 60 herding days.

conditions.description: Allocation is needed for a moved eligible animal.

result.description: RGVE are credited proportionately per alpine pasture.

rules.statement: Herding requires daily proper care, if necessary overnight, for a substantial part of the day and not merely inspection; care includes water, animal care, treatment referral, safety and site-adapted grazing management.

conditions.expression: daily_care and substantive herding controls are true
conditions.description: All documented care elements are available.

result.description: Animal-care obligation is met.

rules.statement: Suitable accommodation and overnight facilities for the responsible person must be available on the alpine pasture; sleeping there is not compulsory when daily duties are fulfilled.

conditions.description: Suitable facility exists on the alpine pasture.

result.description: Accommodation requirement is met.

rules.statement: A requested certified guardian dog must be used on the same alpine pasture throughout the animals’ alpine period and at least 60 days; it must be a permanent day-and-night herd member, work independently, have a recognised certificate and liability cover, and be requested for only one alpine pasture.

conditions.expression: guardian dog eligibility predicates are all true
conditions.description: Dog and documentation satisfy the optional-supplement requirements.

result.description: The dog can receive the optional supplement.

rules.statement: The measure must be applied for by 31 December before contract start; final entry is funding year 2027 (application by 31 December 2026), and final guardian-dog supplement entry is funding year 2028 (application by 31 December 2027).

conditions.description: Deadline depends on requested measure or supplement.

result.description: A valid future annual contract can be created.

rules.statement: The alpine/common-pasture list is the payment application and, together with herders, categories and dogs, is due by 15 July (17 July in 2023 and 2028); only animals driven up by 15 July may be recognised for payment.

conditions.expression: payment list and eligible animal drive-up are timely
conditions.description: Annual payment application timing.

result.description: Timely reported animals can be assessed.

rules.statement: Cattle use the cattle alpine/pasture report within 14 days for drive-up and departure; sheep/goats are individual ear-tag reports within 7 days; equids/camelids have a 7-day drive-up deadline and correction deadline for a changed departure date. Late reports recognise no more than 14 or 7 preceding days respectively.

conditions.description: Species-specific report deadline is met.

result.description: Timely report retains the corresponding alpine days.

rules.statement: Milk flags may be supplied within 14 days after cattle drive-up, or within 7 days after sheep/goat drive-up but not after 15 July; later changes to milk are not possible and an invalid cattle milk flag must be removed immediately.

conditions.expression: milk flag correction is within relevant deadline
conditions.description: Species-specific milk marking rule.

result.description: Milk classification may be paid only when reported correctly.

rules.statement: After the annual term, exit from the measure, individual categories or dog supplement is possible; a deregistration from 1 January to 31 December invalidates the measure for that funding year, so deregister only from the next 1 January after fulfilling that year.

conditions.expression: deregistration date and completed annual duties
conditions.description: Exit timing determines current-year validity.

result.description: Exit applies without invalidating a completed year when timed correctly.

rules.statement: Eligible RGVE use the complete Annex A conversion key and the age reference date is 1 July of the application year.

conditions.expression: animal class has an Annex A factor
conditions.description: Species, age and equid size determine factor.

result.description: Animal count is converted with the legally specified factor.

rules.statement: From 2024, base payment is EUR 81/RGVE for the first 20 and EUR 27 thereafter; milk supplements are EUR 151.20 and EUR 108. From 2025 guardian dogs receive EUR 1,200 each, maximum five per alpine pasture.

conditions.expression: eligible annual RGVE and qualifying milk/dogs
conditions.description: Payment is calculated after eligibility.

result.description: Tiered base, milk and dog payment.

rules.statement: Payment is capped at 50 RGVE per herder; the enhanced first-20-RGVE rate is paid separately per block of 50 RGVE and herder. One person may not herd several alpine pastures for this payment.

conditions.expression: rgve allocated to a distinct herder
conditions.description: Apply the cap and allocate first-rate band per herder.

result.description: At most 50 RGVE are paid for each herder.

rules.statement: Behirtung is assessed separately from the home farm but subject to alpine modulation: 100% through 200, 90% from over 200 through 300, 85% from over 300 through 1,000, and 75% over 1,000; the alpine factor also applies to Behirtung irrespective of herded RGVE.

conditions.expression: alpine holding has modulated relevant extent
conditions.description: Determine blended modulation factor from eligible alpine extent.

result.description: Calculated measure premium is reduced by the alpine factor.

rules.statement: If drought makes obligations impossible, including missing water provision on alpine pastures, an individual request for recognition of force majeure or special circumstances may be submitted through eAMA.

conditions.description: Exceptional circumstances must be submitted individually.

result.description: A force-majeure assessment may protect the otherwise unfulfilled obligation.

rules.statement: The applicant must operate an agricultural holding in its own name and on its own account, control the requested land, and meet active-farmer and agricultural-activity requirements.

conditions.expression: applicant operates and controls the holding and is active farmer
conditions.description: General ÖPUL applicant conditions.

result.description: Applicant may receive ÖPUL funding.

rules.statement: In the first ÖPUL year, the holding must have either 0.50 ha protected cultivation or 1.50 ha total agricultural area in Austria, subject to stated programme exceptions.

conditions.description: First-year holding minimum.

result.description: A first-year ÖPUL contract can be formed.

rules.statement: Funded animals must be held in Austria; animals held outside Austria cannot be considered for payment-relevant livestock numbers or listed in the animal list.

conditions.description: Location of each animal during the relevant period.

result.description: Only Austrian-held animals are credited.

rules.statement: All ÖPUL participants must comply with conditionality rules on climate/environment, public health, plant health, animal welfare and social conditionality to receive the full payment.

conditions.description: Applicable cross-programme conditionality is met.

result.description: No conditionality-based reduction applies.

rules.statement: Compliance is checked administratively, on site and subsequently; substantive violations are assessed by severity, extent, duration and frequency, with reductions through 100%, and two 100% reductions during the contract can exclude the measure and recover prior payments.

conditions.description: Authority assesses the documented breach.

result.description: Measure-level reduction, exclusion and recovery may follow.
